content: W3C Indexed Database API 2.0规范第2.4节定义：A key has an associated type which is one of: number, date, string, binary, or array. The following ECMAScript types are valid keys: Number primitive values (except NaN), Date objects, String primitive values, ArrayBuffer objects, Array objects. Attempting to convert other ECMAScript values to a key will fail. 布尔值（true/false）不是合法的可索引键类型，尝试转换为键将直接失败（抛出DataError）。
conclusion: W3C IndexedDB 2.0规范证明布尔值不是合法索引键类型，禁止直接建boolean索引或where.equals(true)查询
